objective: Normalize the real source-backed Vehicles, Mecha, Spacecraft/Starship, Bases/Facilities and associated component/item catalogs into existing MRCS/MIB-14/D17-compatible identities and references with stable provenance, while leaving source-insufficient facts explicit.
acceptance: Enumerate governed operational-asset source registries and source counts/hashes used by normalization.
Assign each normalizable source record stable source identity, provenance and existing-owner target classification without a new OARC canonical catalog.
Use OARC02 owner-reference syntax for MIB-14-bound records.
Preserve explicit source slot/component/compatibility evidence even when current MIB-14 cannot operationalize it.
Do not infer parent-component relations, compatibility, capacities, system presence or operating envelopes from names/grouping/missing values.
Keep MERA/MBES reserved runtime authority untouched.
boundaries: MRCS remains definition-authoring authority; MIB-14 operational configuration authority; D17 live Asset truth.
PPIA-04 CSV-first source authority and no-name-similarity parentage rule remain binding.
GPR and MRCS lane state remains independent.
